content: Tasiyas nag isimounids
Yowbad inok nuwan yakamey, mo isekem mawotet towen. Mapuna nag ka̱gwey waseg.

Bo kapiyev kalbaleb sinap, o aveiyag kalbaleb nisowmes. Nag kakatidavis gamag. Nag kakatilow Yowbad anilivan. Tage amalivan mounid, kamnat; kukinemas katamanaw wamtamiy, kuliganes amalivan, mo bukukwakins amasinap kamnat. Yowbad ikakin ma̱wan.

Kukin aw-sinap bisowm makageiguy wanuwan; bo isowm wasigeis tasiyas takanka̱nigs. Nag bikakins tasiyas. Nag isimounids. Peinan ven watinow gimgilis sitovek kalbaleb bo ivag ninous ikanig, va̱gan liva̱nen Kelis nag bimteilis tasiyas; Kelis takamnat tonen, ma̱wana Yowbad.
Nag kageiguy livnem, tage liva̱nen Yeisuw Kelis, peinan datoveks, o yakamey mitouwat yakamey, silma̱nin bakawtel Yeisuw nawotet.
Yowbad kweiboug nilivan, ilana, “Kadiloka kamnat bimteil ven, peinan dadub.” Mtowen bo imteil kateids mo takakins yakawanan Yowbad, nises Kelis waseg.
Pawl a̱ban igeg
Sinapun liba̱lab wakatem mamagina veigun bwanabwein wanuwan kaynad kweiboug; peinan tougwey yakamey. Yowbad nakaleiwag ma̱wan va̱gan babaw gamag bikakins tatonen natawtoun singay; yakamey nag.
Babaw gamag iyagagemas, tage nag kakalouw. Isunasun ninom, tage nag kapiyev wotet.
Bo iyagagemas, tage Yowbad nag ilisawem. Iwawemas, tage nag ikatimatemas.
Wom waseg kakokew Yeisuw inamouvit, va̱gan mwamovan Yeisuw mo bikamat wawom.
Igaw mwamov yakamey tut babaw biyagagemas bakakanig, peinan Yeisuw angamag yakamey, va̱gan bukukines mwamovan Yeisuw wawom.
Yakamey wanuwan kanig, tage yakamiy kumwamovs.
Kweiboug teitan nilel mamagina:
Yakamey kasimounid ma̱wan, mapuna kalivan.
Kakakin Yowbad niyakit daGuyaws Yeisuw Kelis kanig waseg, igaw mo biyakituds sods Yeisuw, bitokeids simayas yakamiy bimayeids mo bitatomos wamatan.
Mawotet towen pinamiy yakamiy va̱gan Yowbad nasiwa̱youb biwekeimiy simiyas babaw gamag, mo bikalin nuwads singay, yakamiy o yakamey; babaw ya̱kids bitaya̱kawns Yowbad waseg.
Mapuna nag ka̱gwey. Kaleivids biguya̱gweys, tage Yowbad ikkatimweis kululuwads yam katanok katanok mo tatawtouns.
Gamag iyagagemas, tage nuwanaw mo beikous. Wankuyeim anagids bivakaein, mamagina, Yowbad nasiwa̱youb nag beikous.
Youd tasiyas wamatads takines, tage nag taninuwes. Nuwanaw mo beikous. Tage taninuwes youd tasiyas nag takines. Yowbad navavag tasiyas nag beikous.
